meta.title: Atrium
meta.author: Puryx (TBC & Loonies)
meta.description: The soundtrack of Atrium by TBC & Loonies (March 2008), a 4k intro that won the PC 4k intro competition at Breakpoint 2008 (pouet 50063, Demozoo 4846). Music by Puryx; synth, object generator and rendering by Mentor, object modelling tool by Blueberry, modelling, design and direction by Lemmus (the intro's nfo). It is played by Mentor's 4k synthesizer: per synth three oscillator pairs, an envelope, a pitch drop and noise, through a tree of filter, delay, distortion and mixer machines. 122 BPM, 3:41, 8 synths, 2930 notes. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: the song file (music.asm) was converted by `synth-convert elevated` to the unified synth (pair oscillators, linear timed envelope, pitch drop; the machine tree as tracks, effect devices and mix buses) and imported with `song import` (notes rounded to 960 ticks per beat). Against the original synth code it differs by +0.14 dB loudness and at most 1.08 dB in any octave band, and it passes the timing check against a capture of the released intro (tools/elevated-parity). Track names are derived here from each track's notes; the song file does not name them. No licence is stated for the music: it belongs to its authors. It is published here as an adapted reference copy while the authors are asked for permission, and is removed at their request.
